intro.text: A mythic war that Vorin belief holds the Heralds and the Heraldic Forces are fighting the Voidbringers to win the Tranquiline Halls.

description.text: In myth, the sound of a horn guides the soldiers to the battlefield.
Once the war is won, those who were not part of the Heraldic Forces are believed to rise from sleep and enter the Tranquiline Halls.
